hero.description: ElectionData.MY aspires to be a trusted source of Malaysian election data—so that citizens can use it with confidence. To earn that trust, every single dataset used on this site has been open-sourced and subjected to rigorous expert scrutiny, via the process of peer review. This page documents the academic-grade research and data curation powering the site.
